operations.name: decode
operations.signature: fn decode(source: &SourceOwner, generation: u64, options: DecodeOptions<'_>, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<SceneGraph>
operations.contract: Collect accepted XML stream with take(); lexical source/tokens owners live outside Decoder borrows. Create one CSS sheet/reference index and endpoint/attribute caches; drive events, render child patterns and resume at exact original traversal position; parse owned animation last; publish only after freeze. All legacy variants select options/measurement, not independent decoders.

operations.name: Decoder::new
operations.signature: fn new(source: &'a SourceOwner, tokens: &'a [XmlToken], generation: u64, options: DecodeOptions<'a>, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<Decoder<'a>>
operations.contract: Own builder and bounded continuation stack, borrow external immutable source/tokens, own ephemeral CSS/reference caches borrowing same external data. No self reference. Cancellation invalidates draft and outstanding tickets.

operations.name: Decoder::step
operations.signature: fn step<'s>(&'s mut self, work_quantum: u64, operations: &mut dyn DecodeOperations, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<DecodeEvent<'s>>
operations.contract: Bounded engine handles XML-depth/inherited style/viewport/transform/group/text stacks and local use expansions. No calls from lower definition/media/paint modules back into engine; planners enqueue typed child/post operations.

operations.name: Decoder::resume_pattern
operations.signature: fn resume_pattern(&mut self, ticket: PatternTicket, result: Result<Tile>, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<()>
operations.contract: After request view borrow ends, validate ticket/dimensions/capacity; move rendered pixels once into pattern; update cache/budget then continue same position. Error aborts job, no fallback or skipping. Nested patterns finish before parent event.

operations.name: Decoder::finish
operations.signature: fn finish(self, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<SceneGraph>
operations.contract: Only Complete state allowed; all indices/ranges/inverses/graph and pattern readiness checked; move arrays and Arc clone, no parsing or source copy.

operations.name: SceneBuilder operations
operations.signature: fn checkpoint(&self, scene: SceneId) -> BuildMark; fn append_shape(&mut self, scene: SceneId, shape: Shape, path: Option<PathDocument>, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<ShapeId>; fn rollback(&mut self, mark: BuildMark); fn seal_child(&mut self, scene: SceneId) -> Result<()>; fn freeze(self) -> Result<SceneGraph>
operations.contract: Every append transaction covers colors/IDs/stroke/dashes/source and path table rebases; rollback drops media/temp allocations once; error commits no partially visible shape. Private mutable table access through mark-scoped writer only.

operations.name: read tables
operations.signature: fn root(&self) -> SceneView<'_>; fn source(&self) -> &[u8]; fn source_owner(&self) -> &SourceOwner; fn tables(&self) -> ViewTables<'_>; fn shape(&self, id: ShapeId) -> Option<&Shape>; fn fill_paint(&self, id: ShapeId) -> Option<&Paint>; fn stroke_paint(&self, id: ShapeId) -> Option<&Paint>; fn dash_values(&self, id: ShapeId) -> Option<&[f64]>
operations.contract: All access checks range before slice; ViewTables enumerates every SceneData table plus graph child lookup, viewport, ignored, animation view. Mutable legacy paint accessors exist only on builder/frame, never shared SceneGraph.

operations.name: geometry
operations.signature: fn geometry(element: ElementView<'_>, flavor: DecodeFlavor, style: &CssPaint<'_>, transform: Affine, builder: &mut SceneBuilder, scene: SceneId, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<TableRange>
operations.contract: Entire shape_geometry/path/custom API: primitives, poly lists, transformed tolerance, implicit fill closure, open stroke, source numbers/segments/subpaths. Reuse accepted path parser and G3 flatten/number cursor; custom glyph/image geometry passes owned edges/metadata into same style finalization transaction.

operations.name: style
operations.signature: fn parse_style(source: &[u8], paint: &CssPaint<'_>, percentage_reference: f64, transform: Affine, viewport: Viewport, builder: &mut SceneBuilder, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<ResolvedStyle>
operations.contract: ResolvedStyle owns fill [u8;4], Stroke, fill/stroke server spans, clip/filter/mask/marker spans, opacity, visibility/display, blend/isolation; no borrowed CSS retained after decode. Preserve currentColor, dash compaction, alpha rounding, non-scaling stroke, join fallback, crisp edges and paint order.

operations.name: resolve
operations.signature: fn resolve_fill(ctx: &mut ResolveContext<'_>, value: XmlSpan, edges: &[Edge], user_inverse: Affine, viewport: [f64;2], control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<ResolvedPaint>
operations.contract: ResolveContext borrows source/tokens + mutable CSS/reference/cache and stop append transaction; ResolvedPaint contains Paint and owned new stops before commit. Local linear/radial href inheritance, stop CSS/currentColor, ordering, spread, focal/radius defaults, bbox/inverse handling unchanged. Pattern classified and sent to planner. Cache keyed complete resolution context, charge all probes/token visits.

operations.name: sample
operations.signature: fn sample(paint: &Paint, stops: &[PaintStop], x: f64, y: f64) -> [u8;4]
operations.contract: Exact C interpolation/clamping/rounding and transform operation order; stop range validated before hot loop; edge_span accessor returns None for empty/invalid range (formed false equivalent). Cache destroy is owned Drop.

operations.name: plan definitions
operations.signature: fn plan<'src, 'ctx>(ctx: &mut DefinitionContext<'src, 'ctx>, kind: DefinitionKind, element: ElementId, owner: ShapeId, transform: Affine, bounds: [f64;4], style: &CssPaint<'src>, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<DefinitionPlan<'src>>
operations.contract: DefinitionContext supplies borrowed source/tokens + mutable CSS/reference and shared counters/active-definition stack, builder append interface; DefinitionPlan<'src> contains one or more Expansion<'src> with source-borrowed CssPaint<'src>, postoperation and full parsed descriptor. CssSheet<'src> and ReferenceIndex<'src> retain their accepted source borrows; DefinitionContext<'src, 'ctx> separately ties mutable container, active-stack, counter and builder borrows to temporary 'ctx, while the result retains only 'src. Control is separately borrowed. This permits the context and all mutable control borrows to end when the method returns DefinitionPlan<'src>. Includes all clip/filter/mask/pattern/marker files, strict local hrefs, units, regions, viewBox, definition ancestor style, cache keys and instance limits. Engine executes expansions; definitions never recurse into engine directly.

operations.name: clip mutation
operations.signature: fn create_rect(points: [Point;4], user_inverse: Affine, owner: Option<TransformId>, builder: &mut SceneBuilder) -> Result<ClipId>; fn apply_group(builder: &mut SceneBuilder, scene: SceneId, shapes: TableRange, clip: ClipId) -> Result<()>; fn clone_clips(view: SceneView<'_>, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<ClipOverlay>; fn update_owner(overlay: &mut ClipOverlay, id: ClipId, owner: TransformId, user_inverse: Affine, attribute_inverse: Affine, bounds: [f64;4]) -> Result<()>
operations.contract: No raw retain/release; clone overlay deduplicates shared ClipId to preserve sharing. Direct original token range in Clip flavor replaces scratch wrapper/reparse; retain wrapper-length/reference admission cap, original clip-rule restrictions and diagnostic offsets; actual allocation counters record actual buffers only.

module_policy: safe std-only Rust domain crates; every target module <=800 lines by cohesive split; no manifests or code changed

context_types.ResolveContext: borrowed source/tokens, mutable accepted ReferenceIndex/CssSheet and PaintCache, SceneBuilder stop transaction, shared ChargeLedger
context_types.DefinitionContext: struct DefinitionContext<'src, 'ctx> { source: &'src [u8], tokens: &'src [vexel_xml::XmlToken], css: &'ctx mut CssSheet<'src>, references: &'ctx mut ReferenceIndex<'src>, active: &'ctx mut ActiveDefinitions, counters: &'ctx mut DecodeCounters, builder: &'ctx mut SceneBuilder } // source and tokens retain source lifetime; accepted CSS/reference containers borrow that same source; every mutable context/control borrow is independent and temporary; same plus active definition identity stack, scene/shape bounds and immutable inherited contexts
context_types.ResolvedPaint: Paint plus Vec<PaintStop> new stops, committed only after validation
context_types.ResolvedStyle: typed parsed RGBA/Stroke and source XmlSpan references for deferred paint/clip/filter/mask/marker, opacity, visibility/display/blend/isolation
context_types.DefinitionPlan<'src>: struct DefinitionPlan<'src> { descriptor: DefinitionDescriptor, expansions: Vec<Expansion<'src>>, post: PostOperation } // expansions preserve CssPaint<'src> source borrows; no engine pointer/callback
context_types.ClipOverlay: owned clips and base ClipId -> overlay ClipId translation; no Arc graph references
context_types.ViewTables: borrowed slices of every SceneData table, child SceneView checked lookup; EvaluatedFrame accessor substitutes changed tables without cloning borrowed ones
context_types.Limits: all original macro limits in ownership-matrix.json plus explicit reserved byte/task/work caps; smaller caller budget opt-in, no smaller default parity renderer
context_types.CounterMark: all document text/image/reference/paint/transform/expansion counters and active depths necessary to roll back failure; accumulated work never rolled back
